name: reusable-offline-sync
goal: A new app can install a framework-neutral IndexedDB cache and offline mutation replay engine with configuration only, while Fluora preserves its existing database and sync behavior through a thin adapter.

evidence: Both repositories now have planned feature specifications with measurable compatibility, API, migration, test, and integration gates.

Framework-neutral IndexedDB adapter, cache contracts, serialized mutation replay engine, retry policies, and application callbacks are implemented; Fluora compiles and builds through a thin local adapter.
10 package tests and 23 focused Fluora offline/API tests pass, including legacy IndexedDB migration, ordering, backoff, policy resolution, and concurrency.

Verified package checks, types, lint, 10 unit tests, browser build, and Harness audit; Fluora passed check, lint, production build, 585 unit tests, 3 WebKit iPhone offline-route tests, and authenticated local browser smoke while installed from the public GitHub package commit.
